rules.name: Martial Mastery
rules.effect:
At the start of the battle round, you can select one of the bullet points below. If you do, until the start of the next battle round, that bullet point’s effects apply.

- Each time an ^^**Adeptus Custodes^^** model from your army with the Martial Ka'tah ability makes a melee attack, a successful unmodified attack roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.
- Improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of melee weapons equipped by ^^**Adeptus Custodes^^** models from your army with the Martial Ka'tah ability by 1.

stratagems.name: Arcane Genetic Alchemy
stratagems.timing: Any phase, just after a mortal wound has been allocated to an ADEPTUS CUSTODES model from your army(excluding ANATHEMA PSYKANA models).
stratagems.cond: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES model’s unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 4+ ability against mortal wounds.
stratagems.summary: Feel No Pain 4+ vs mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: Avenge the Fallen
stratagems.timing: Start of the Fight phase.
stratagems.cond: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army (excluding ANATHEMA PSYKANA units) that is below its Starting Strength.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in that unit. If your unit is Below Half-strength, until the end of the phase, add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of those melee weapons instead.
stratagems.summary: +1 Attacks to melee weapons; +2 if Below Half-strength.

stratagems.name: Unwavering Sentinels
stratagems.timing: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.cond: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY unit from your army (excluding ANATHEMA PSYKANA units) that is within range of an objective marker you control and that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a melee attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
stratagems.summary: -1 to Hit rolls on melee attacks targeting unit.

stratagems.name: Multipotentiality
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.cond: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army that Fell Back this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of your turn, that unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.
stratagems.summary: Eligible to shoot and charge after Fall Back this turn.

stratagems.name: Vigilance Eternal
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.cond: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES BATTLELINE unit from your army (excluding ANATHEMA PSYKANA units) within range of an objective marker you control.
stratagems.effect: That objective marker remains under your control even if you have no models within range of it, until your opponent controls it at the start or end of any turn.
stratagems.summary: Hold objective without models in range until opponent controls it.

stratagems.name: Archeotech Munitions
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.cond: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army (excluding ANATHEMA PSYKANA units) that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Select either the [LETHAL HITS] or [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. Until the end of the phase ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the selected ability.
stratagems.summary: Grant [LETHAL HITS] or [SUSTAINED HITS 1] to ranged weapons.

enhancements.name: Castellan's Mark
enhancements.effect: After both players have deployed their armies, you can select up to two **ADEPTUS CUSTODES** units from your army (excluding **ANATHEMA PSYKANA** units) and redeploy all of those units. When doing so, any of those units can be placed into Strategic Reserves, regardless of how  any units are already in Strategic Reserves.

enhancements.name: Panoptispex
enhancements.effect: While the bearer is leading a unit, ranged weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability.

enhancements.name: From the Hall of Armouries
enhancements.effect: Add 1 to the Strength and Damage characteristics of the bearer's melee weapons.

enhancements.name: Auric Mantle
enhancements.effect: **^^Shield-Captain^^** or **^^Blade Champion^^** model only. Add 2 to the bearer's Wounds characteristic.

rules.name: Revered Companions
rules.effect:
^^**Anathema Psykana^^** units from your army gain the following ability:
**Null Aegis (Aura)**: While an ^^**Adeptus Custodes^^** unit is within 6" of this unit, models in that unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability against Psychic Attacks and mortal wounds.


All other **^^Adeptus Custodes**^^ units from your army gain the following ability:
**Deadly Unity (Aura)**: While an **^Anathema Psykana^^** unit is within 6" of this unit, each time a model in that ^^**Anathema Psykana^^** unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: Hunt as One
stratagems.timing: Start of your Movement phase.
stratagems.cond: Up to two ADEPTUS CUSTODES units from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your units are eilgible to shoot and/or declare a charge in a turn in which they Fell Back.
stratagems.summary: Eligible to shoot/charge after Fall Back this turn.

stratagems.name: Talons Interlocked
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.cond: Up to two ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY units from your army, and one enemy unit that is an eligible target for all of those units.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your units can only target that enemy unit, but each time a model in one of your units makes a ranged attack, improve the Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics of that attack by 1.
stratagems.summary: Your units can only target that enemy; +1 Strength and AP on ranged attacks.

stratagems.name: Empyric Severance
stratagems.timing: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.cond: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks, and one friendly ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit within 6" of that ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Feel No Pain 4+ ability against Psychic attacks and mortal wounds.
stratagems.summary: Feel No Pain 4+ vs Psychic attacks and mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: Emperor’s Executioners
stratagems.timing: Start of the Fight phase.
stratagems.cond: Up to two ADEPTUS CUSTODES units from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in one of your units targets an enemy unit that is below its Starting Strength, add 1 to the Wound roll.
stratagems.summary: +1 to Wound rolls vs units below Starting Strength.

stratagems.name: Taloned Pincer
stratagems.timing: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
stratagems.cond: Up to two ADEPTUS CUSTODES units from your army that are within 8" of that enemy unit.
stratagems.effect: Your units can make a Normal move of up to 6".
stratagems.summary: Your units make a Normal move of up to 6".

stratagems.name: Shield of Honour
stratagems.timing: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.cond: One ANATHEMA PSYKANA INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks, and one other friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY unit (excluding ANATHEMA PSYKANA units) within 6" of that ANATHEMA PSYKANA INFANTRY unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, any attack that targets your ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit must instead target your other ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit (unless it is not an eligible target).
stratagems.summary: Redirect attacks on ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit to another ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.

enhancements.name: Radiant Mantle
enhancements.effect: Each time an attack targets the bearer's unit, if the attacking model is within 12", subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

enhancements.name: Aegis Projector
enhancements.effect: Once per turn, the first time a saving throw is failed for the bearer's unit, change the Damage characteristic of that attack to 0.

enhancements.name: Gift of Terran Artifice
enhancements.effect: Each time the bearer makes a melee attack, add 1 to the Wound roll.

enhancements.name: Champion of the Imperium
enhancements.effect: The range of the bearer’s Null Aegis or Deadly Unity ability is increased to 9".

rules.name: Creeping Dread (Aura)
rules.effect: In the Battle-shock step of your opponent's Command phase, if an enemy unit that is either a ^^**Psyker^^** unit or below its Starting Strength is within 12" of one or more ^^**Anathema Psykana^^** models from your army, that enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test. If that unit is below Half-strength, it must subtract 1 from its Battle-shock test this phase instead.

stratagems.name: Desperation’s Price
stratagems.timing: Any phase, just after an enemy PSYKER unit has either finished using a Psychic ability that targets a unit, or finished making Psychic Attacks.
stratagems.cond: One ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit from your army within 18" of that enemy PSYKER unit.
stratagems.effect: That enemy PSYKER unit must take a Leadership test If the test is passed, that PSYKER unit is Battle-shocked; if the test is failed that PSYKER unit suffers 3 mortal wounds and is Battle-shocked.
stratagems.summary: Enemy PSYKER takes Leadership test: pass = Battle-shocked; fail = 3 mortal wounds + Battle-shocked.

stratagems.name: Witch Hunters
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.cond: One ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Select either the [LETHAL HITS] or [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have the selected ability, but models in your unit can only target PSYKER units with their attacks.
stratagems.summary: Grant [LETHAL HITS] or [SUSTAINED HITS 1] to unit's weapons; can only target PSYKER units.

stratagems.name: Anathema Blademastery
stratagems.timing: Fight phase.
stratagems.cond: One VIGILATORS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a melee attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll If the target of that attack is Battle-shocked or a PSYKER, you can re-roll the Wound roll as well.
stratagems.summary: Re-roll Hit rolls; re-roll Wound rolls vs Battle-shocked or PSYKER targets.

stratagems.name: Psy-chaff Volley
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.cond: One PROSECUTORS unit from your army that has just shot.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the start of your next turn, while your unit is on the battlefield, that enemy unit is prosecuted. While a unit is prosecuted, each time an ANATHEMA PSYKANA model makes an attack against that unit, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1. While a PSYKER or Battle-shocked unit is prosecuted, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
stratagems.summary: Select enemy unit hit; until start of next turn, that unit is prosecuted. ANATHEMA PSYKANA attacks gain +1 AP against it. PSYKER or Battle-shocked prosecuted units subtract 1 from Hit rolls.

stratagems.name: Purgation Sweep
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.cond: One WITCHSEEKERS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of Torrent weapons equipped by models in your unit. If such a weapon targets a PSYKER or Battle-shocked unit this phase, add 2 to its Attacks characteristic instead.
stratagems.summary: +1 Attacks to Torrent weapons; +2 if targeting PSYKER or Battle-shocked.

stratagems.name: Psychic Abominations
stratagems.timing: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.cond: One ANATHEMA PSYKANA INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Stealth ability, and Battle-shocked and PSYKER models can only select your unit as a target of a ranged attack if they are within 12".
stratagems.summary: Gain Stealth; Battle-shocked and PSYKER models can only target from within 12".

enhancements.name: Raptor Blade
enhancements.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks, Strength and Damage characteristics of the bearer's melee weapons. While the bearer is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy **^^Psyker^^** units that are Battle-shocked, add 2 to the Attacks, Strength and Damage characteristics of the bearer's melee weapons instead.

enhancements.name: Enhanced Voidsheen Cloak
enhancements.effect: Each time an attack is allocated to the bearer, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack. If that attack was made by a **^^Psyker^^** or Battle-shocked model, change the Damage characteristic of that attack to 1 instead.

enhancements.name: Huntress' Eye
enhancements.effect: In your Command phase, select one enemy unit within 12" of the bearer. That unit must take a Battle-shock test.

enhancements.name: Oblivion Knight
enhancements.effect: While the bearer is leading a unit, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll. If that attack targeted an enemy **^^Psyker^^** unit, add 1 to the Wound roll as well.

rules.name: Assemblage of Might
rules.effect: At the start of your Command phase, select one unit from your opponent’s army. Until the start of your next Command phase, each time a model in an ^^**Adeptus Custodes Character^^** unit from your army makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, add 1 to the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: Slayer of Champions
stratagems.timing: Any phase.
stratagems.cond: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES CHARACTER unit from your army that has just destroyed the unit you selected at the start of your Command phase as the target of your Assemblage of Might ability.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit on the battlefield Until the start of your next Command phase, each time an ADEPTUS CUSTODES CHARACTER model from your army makes an attack that target that enemy unit, add 1 to the Wound roll In addition, if the destroyed unit was a CHARACTER unit, gain 1CP.
stratagems.summary: +1 to Wound rolls vs selected enemy unit; gain 1CP if that unit is a CHARACTER and is destroyed.

stratagems.name: Superhuman Reserves
stratagems.timing: Any phase, just after an ADEPTUS CUSTODES WARLORD model from your army has used an ability on its datasheet or from an Enhancement that says it can only be used Once per battle.
stratagems.cond: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES WARLORD model.
stratagems.effect: Your model can use its Once per battle’ ability one additional time during this battle (but not in the same phase).
stratagems.summary: Use 'Once per battle' ability one additional time (different phase).

stratagems.name: The Emperor’s Auspice
stratagems.timing: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.cond: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES CHARACTER unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, CHARACTER models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 4+ ability.
stratagems.summary: CHARACTER models gain Feel No Pain 4+.

stratagems.name: Earning of a Name
stratagems.timing: Fight phase.
stratagems.cond: Up to two ADEPTUS CUSTODES CHARACTER units from your army that have not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a CHARACTER model in either of your units makes an attack that targets a MONSTER or VEHICLE unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.
stratagems.summary: Re-roll Hit and Wound rolls for CHARACTER attacks vs MONSTER/VEHICLE.

stratagems.name: Vigil Unending
stratagems.timing: Fight phase.
stratagems.cond: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES CHARACTER model from your army that was just destroyed and has not fought this phase. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.effect: Do not remove your destroyed model from play. The destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making attacks, and is then removed from play.
stratagems.summary: Destroyed model fights before removal from play.

stratagems.name: Shoulder the Mantle
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase, before the Reinforcements step.
stratagems.cond: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES CHARACTER model from your army that is not leading a unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one friendly unit (excluding Battle-shocked and Attached units) within 2" horizontally and 5" vertically of your model that it could lead (as described in the Leader section of its datasheet). Your model attaches to that unit as a Leader. Change that unit’s Starting Strength accordingly.
stratagems.summary: Attach your model as Leader to eligible friendly unit within 2" horizontally and 5" vertically; update unit's Starting Strength.

enhancements.name: Blade Imperator
enhancements.effect: Each time the bearer's unit ends a Charge move, select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of the bearer and roll one D6: on a 4+, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds. Once per battle, when the bearer's unit ends a Charge move, all enemy units within 6" of the bearer must take a Battle-shock test.

enhancements.name: Inspirational Exemplar
enhancements.effect: The bearer has a Leadership characteristic of 5+. Once per battle, at the start of any phase, you can select one friendly **^^Adeptus Custodes^^** unit that is Battle-shocked and within 12" of the bearer: that unit is no longer Battle-shocked.

enhancements.name: Veiled Blade
enhancements.effect: Add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of the bearer's melee weapons. Once per battle, at the start of any Command phase, triple the bearer's Objective Control characteristic until the end of the turn.

enhancements.name: Martial Philosopher
enhancements.effect: Once per battle, in your opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move within 8" of the bearer, if the bearer's unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, it can make a Normal move of up to 6".

rules.name: Auric Armour
rules.effect:
■ While an ^^**Adeptus Custodes Vehicle^^** unit from your army is at Starting Strength, unless that unit is an ^^**Aircraft^^** or it is Battle‑shocked, add 2 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in that unit.

■ While an ^^**Adeptus Custodes Vehicle^^** unit from your army is below Starting Strength, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, re‑roll a Hit roll of 1.

■ While an ^^**Adeptus Custodes Vehicle^^** unit from your army is Below Half‑strength, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, re‑roll a Hit roll of 1 and re‑roll a Wound roll of 1.

rules.name: Moritoi Ancients
rules.effect: Add 2" to the Move characteristic of models in ^^**Adeptus Custodes Walker^^** units from your army and add 1 to  Advance and Charge rolls made for such units.

stratagems.name: Flawless Construction
stratagems.timing: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.cond: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES VEHICLE unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets a model in your unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than the Toughness characteristic of your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.
stratagems.summary: -1 to Wound rolls if attack Strength > unit Toughness.

stratagems.name: Emperor’s Vengeance
stratagems.timing: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.cond: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, adding 1 to the result if your unit has the WALKER keyword. On a 4+, do not remove it from play; The destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks (when doing so, it is assumed to have 1 wound remaining), and is then removed from play.
stratagems.summary: Destroyed model fights back on 4+ (5+ if not WALKER); has 1 wound; removed after fighting.

stratagems.name: Wrathful Advance
stratagems.timing: Fight phase, just before an ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army Piles In.
stratagems.cond: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Pile-in move, it can move up to D3+3" instead of up to 3".
stratagems.summary: Pile-in moves gain +D3" (up to D3+3" instead of 3").

stratagems.name: Unstoppable
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.
stratagems.cond: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES VEHICLE or ADEPTUS CUSTODES MOUNTED unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a move, it can move through terrain features.
stratagems.summary: Move through terrain features.

stratagems.name: Relentless Persecution
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase, just after an ADEPTUS CUSTODES VEHICLE unit from your army Advances.
stratagems.cond: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES VEHICLE unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Advanced. If your unit has the WALKER keyword, until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced instead.
stratagems.summary: Shoot after Advancing; WALKER units also declare charges after Advancing.

stratagems.name: Punishment Inescapable
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.cond: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability, and until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can ignore any or all modifiers to that attack’s Ballistic Skill characteristic and/or any or all modifiers to the Hit roll.
stratagems.summary: Ranged weapons gain [IGNORES COVER]; ignore BS/Hit roll modifiers on your attacks.

enhancements.name: Honoured Fallen (Aura)
enhancements.effect: ADEPTUS CUSTODES VEHICLE model only. While a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY or ADEPTUS CUSTODES MOUNTED unit is within 6" of the bearer, each time a model in that unit makes  an attack, re‑roll a Hit roll of 1.

enhancements.name: Augury Uplink
enhancements.effect: ADEPTUS CUSTODES model only. The bearer has the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.

enhancements.name: Adamantine Talisman
enhancements.effect: **^^Adeptus Custodes^^** model only. Improve the Attacks, Strength and Damage characteristics of melee weapons equipped by the bearer by 1.

enhancements.name: Veteran of the Kataphraktoi
enhancements.effect: ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY or ADEPTUS CUSTODES MOUNTED model only. In your Command phase, select one ADEPTUS CUSTODES VEHICLE or ADEPTUS CUSTODES MOUNTED unit within 6" of the bearer. Until the start of your next Command phase, that unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back.

rules.name: Against All Odds
rules.effect: Each time an ^^**Adeptus Custodes^^** unit from your army (excluding ^^**Vehicles^^**) makes an attack, if there are no other friendly units within 6" of that unit, add 1 to the Hit roll and add 1 to the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: Gilded Champion
stratagems.timing: Any phase, just after an ADEPTUS CUSTODES CHARACTER model from your army has used an ability on its datasheet that states it can only be used ‘once per battle’.
stratagems.cond: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES CHARACTER model.
stratagems.effect: Your model can use that ‘once per battle’ ability one additional time during the battle (but not in the same phase).
stratagems.summary: Model can use its 'once per battle' ability one additional time (different phase).

stratagems.name: Defiant to the Last
stratagems.timing: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.cond: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, adding 2 to the result if that model has the CHARACTER keyword. On a 4+, do not remove it from play; the destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks (when doing so, it is treated as having 1 wound remaining), and is then removed from play.
stratagems.summary: Destroyed model not yet fought: roll D6 (+2 if CHARACTER); 4+ doesn't remove it, fights with 1 wound after attacker finishes, then removed.

stratagems.name: Peerless Warrior
stratagems.timing: Fight phase.
stratagems.cond: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [PRECISION] ability.
stratagems.summary: Grant [PRECISION] to unit's melee weapons.

stratagems.name: Unleash the Lions
stratagems.timing: Your Command phase.
stratagems.cond: One ALLARUS CUSTODIANS or AQUILON CUSTODIANS unit from your army that is on the battlefield.
stratagems.effect: That unit is split into separate units, each containing one model. These new units each have a Starting Strength of 1.
stratagems.summary: Split into separate 1-model units with Starting Strength 1.

stratagems.name: Manoeuvre and Fire
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase, just after an ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army Falls Back.
stratagems.cond: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.
stratagems.summary: Fell Back unit can shoot and declare charge this turn.

stratagems.name: Swift as the Eagle
stratagems.timing: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
stratagems.cond: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army (excluding VEHICLE units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6".
stratagems.summary: Make a Normal move of up to D6".

enhancements.name: Superior Creation
enhancements.effect: **^^Adeptus Custodes Infantry^^** model only. The first time the bearer is destroyed, roll one D6 at the end of the phase. On a 2+, set the bearer back up on the battlefield, as close as possible to where it was destroyed and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, with its full wounds remaining.

enhancements.name: Praesidius
enhancements.effect: The bearer has the Lone Operative and Stealth abilities.

enhancements.name: Fierce Conqueror
enhancements.effect: At the start of the Fight phase, until the end of the phase, add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by the bearer for every 5 enemy models within 6" of the bearer (rounding  down).

enhancements.name: Admonimortis
enhancements.effect: **^^Shield‑Captain^^** model only. Improve the Strength characteristic of melee weapons equipped by the bearer by 3, and improve the Armour Penetration and Damage characteristics of those weapons by  1.

rules.name: March of the Honoured Dead
rules.effect:

This ability always takes the form **Deadly Demise X**. Each time a model in this unit is **destroyed**, after the units embarked within it (if any) have made their **emergency disembark moves**, roll one D6. On a 6, that model suffers a **deadly demise**; each unit within 6" of that model suffers a number of **mortal wounds** denoted by **X** (if this is a random number, roll separately for each unit within 6").

These are inflicted after resolving any normal damage inflicted by those attacks. 
**Mortal wounds** inflicted by **[DEVASTATING WOUNDS]** weapons can damage a maximum of one model for each **critical wound**; any remaining **mortal wounds** inflicted by that attack are lost. 
***Example:** An attack made with a **[DEVASTATING WOUNDS]** weapon with a **D** characteristic of 3 results in a **critical wound** against an Intercessor Squad, so inflicts 3 **mortal wounds**. glossary.name: Lone Operative
glossary.effect:
Unless part of an **attached** unit, this unit is not **visible** to enemy models unless they are within 12" of this unit, and it cannot be targeted by **[INDIRECT FIRE]** weapons unless the attacking model is within 12" of this unit. 
If this ability takes the form **Lone Operative X"**, unless part of an **attached** unit, this unit is not **visible** to enemy models unless they are within **X"** of this unit, and it cannot be targeted by **[INDIRECT FIRE]** weapons unless the attacking model is within **X"** of this unit.

glossary.name: Extra Attacks
glossary.effect:
Each time a unit containing one or more models with an **[EXTRA ATTACKS]** weapon fights, those models will make attacks with those weapons in addition to any others. In the Select Weapons step (04.01), for each of those models, you must select: 
- All of that model’s **[EXTRA ATTACKS]** weapons. 
- One of that model’s other melee weapons, if possible.
